notes.title: Finally on Store
notes.content:
We just launched our first game on Steam. It's a medium-to-fast paced arcade game, featuring our two main characters: Lola and Benny Hiro. Your goal is to defeat the enemies by shooting in a slingshot manner, while  carefully managing the kind of resources you collect (and use).
Don't forget to check the underground Upgrades and Badges menu sections; you can access these by clicking on the carrot that is on the bottom of the Main Menu screen.
